MANGESH PUTRAN 
Senior Data Engineer 
9967530210  mangesh.putran28@gmail.com  Linkedin 
 
A highly skilled and Seasoned Data Engineer with 5 years of experience specializing in resilient data architecture and 
modernization. Deep expertise in transforming complex data challenges into robust, real -time solutions, leveraging Apache Spark

development, coupled with DevOps practices to ensure continuous integration and deployment of critical data platforms.

 Languages  - Python,  Scala, SQL (Advanced),  Bash, Shell, Java, Javascript.  
 Cloud Computing  - AWS (S3, Athena,  RDS, EC2, EMR), Azure (ADLS,  Databricks,  Synapse),  GCP (BigQuery,  Dataflow)  
  Workflow  Orchestration  - Apache  Airflow,  DevOps  & CI/CD, Docker,  Grafana,  PostgreSQL,  MySQL,  Kubernetes,  GitLab.  
 
WORK  EXPERIENCE  
Nielsen Media | 2024 - Current | Senior Data Engineer 
Tech Stack - Pyspark, Scala, AWS S3, RDS, EC2, SQS, Airflow, Sql, Postgress, Kubernatics, Docker

deployment to accelerate release cycles and enforce high standards of code quality.
